title: MUCAR: Benchmarking Multilingual Cross-Modal Ambiguity Resolution for Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The MUCAR benchmark includes a specific 'Cultural' category (90 samples) for evaluating models. This category utilizes religious and spiritual contexts to test ambiguity resolution, such as a case study that requires the model to correctly interpret the symbol '666' based on its biblical significance in Western Christian traditions versus its use as praise in modern Chinese slang.
